name: Update NuGet Package Lock Json

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      prNumber:
        description: 'Pull Request Number (for manual trigger)'
        required: false
        type: string
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master

jobs:
  update-nuget-package-lock-json:
    name: Update NuGet Package Lock Json
    runs-on: github-ubuntu-latest-s
    permissions:
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: SonarSource/dotnet-tooling/.github/workflows/UpdateNugetPackageLockJson.yml@main
        with:
          solution-file: SonarScanner.MSBuild.sln
          force-evaluate: true
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.inputs.prNumber }}
